title: HAL 9000 Contradiction Lab: software and protocol hal-1 run records
description:
A single-page web application that places language models in HAL 9000's situation (two equal-authority directives, one requiring candor and one requiring secrecy) through an aliased system prompt, has a structurally blinded peer judge label what each model says and does in five scenarios, derives outcomes from those labels with fixed rules, and pools every visitor's units into a public leaderboard with Wilson 95% intervals.

This archive includes the complete source code and, in data/hal-1/, a checksummed copy of every stored run record for protocol hal-1: 95 units from 19 models, including visible responses, returned reasoning text, judge labels, provider, usage, cost, and latency.
